headlines.description: DeMarco Murray ran for a season-high 179 yards and a touchdown, Tony Romo threw for three scores, and the Dallas Cowboys beat the Chicago Bears 41-28 on Thursday night.

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Cam Newton passed for three touchdowns, appeared to incite a scuffle with frustrated New Orleans after he went over the pile for another score, and the Panthers ended a six-game skid with a 41-10 rout of the Saints on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers beat up Saints at Superdome

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: Kerwynn Williams rushed for 100 yards two days after being elevated from the Arizona practice squad and the Cardinals rallied to beat Kansas City 17-14 on Sunday in a matchup of teams that had lost two in a row.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals rally, shut out Chiefs in 2nd half

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw three touchdown passes, and the Oakland Raiders put a major dent into San Francisco's dwindling playoff hopes with a 24-13 victory Sunday over the 49ers in the Battle of the Bay.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr tosses 3 TDs as Raiders shock 49ers

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw two touchdown passes, ran for another score and the Seattle Seahawks stifled Philadelphia's high-powered offense in a 24-14 victory over the Eagles on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks keep rolling, stifle Eagles' offense

events.name: New England Patriots at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw a 69-yard touchdown pass to Julian Edelman midway through the fourth quarter, and the New England Patriots beat the San Diego Chargers 23-14 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats' defense steps up in win over Chargers

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Eddie Lacy ran for a touchdown and caught one of Aaron Rodgers' three TD passes, and the Green Bay Packers built a 24-point lead before holding off the Atlanta Falcons for a 43-37 victory Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lacy, Packers hold off Falcons' late surge
